tasks.original_instruction: Pick up the pen holder and place all the pens into it.
tasks.modified_instruction: Pick up and hold the pen holder upright, insert all three pens one by one, then place the filled holder on the table.

tasks.original_instruction: Place all the objects on the table into the basket.
tasks.modified_instruction: Place all objects on the table into the basket one by one.

tasks.task_name: Stack Blocks and Cover with Cup
tasks.original_instruction: Stack the blocks on the table, then cover them with the cup.
tasks.modified_instruction: Stack all three blocks into one vertical stack, then place the cup over the entire stack.

tasks.original_instruction: Stack the bowls on the table.
tasks.modified_instruction: Nest all three bowls upright at the center of the table.
Place all three bottles stably upright on the table.

tasks.original_instruction: Insert the charger plug into the power strip, then connect the charging cable to the plug.
tasks.modified_instruction: Insert the charger plug into the power strip, then connect the charging cable to the charger plug.
